name: ui/mzizi-verified-badge
title: MziziVerifiedBadge
summary: The compact view of trust: a round mark in the verification tier's colour, named by the tier ("Government Verified"). Tier 0 renders nothing; a suspended account shows the ban glyph, an ancestral one the memorial flower. The trust score is in the name only with `showScore`. Server-rendered; colour from the tier's own --tier-* container pair.

props.name: tier
props.description: The verification tier code (system.verification_tier.tier_code). `unverified` renders nothing.

props.name: status
props.description: The platform status (identity.person.mit_status). Suspended shows the ban glyph on the neutral pair; either ancestral status shows the memorial flower in the tier's colour.

props.name: size
props.description: 14, 18, 24 or 32px: inline with text, cards and headers, profile pages, verification detail views.

props.name: showTooltip
props.description: Set the native `title` to the badge's name. There is no tooltip component.

props.name: label
props.description: The wording, in place of the built-in name (the tier's label, "Account Suspended" or "<tier> — Memorial"). It is the title and, unless `ariaLabel` is set, the accessible name.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The accessible name, when it should differ from `label`.

props.name: showScore
props.description: Add the tier's cumulative trust score (" · Trust 0.2") to the title and the accessible name. Off by default (#550).

props.name: loading
props.description: Render a muted, pulsing placeholder, hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: The badge is a <span role="img"> whose aria-label is the name: `ariaLabel`, else `label`, else the built-in name. The glyph inside it is decorative (aria-hidden).
The built-in name is the tier's label (Community Verified, Contact Verified, Government Verified, Licensed Professional); "Account Suspended" when suspended; "<tier label> — Memorial" when ancestral.
With `showScore` the name ends " · Trust <cumulative score>"; without it no number is in the title or the name.
With `showTooltip` (the default) the title is the name, without `ariaLabel`'s override.

Each tier draws from its own pair: fill `bg-tier-<tier>-container` and glyph `text-tier-<tier>-on-container`. Suspended uses the unverified (neutral) pair. The glyphs are users, phone, shield-check and award; ban when suspended; flower when ancestral.
Tier 0 (`unverified`) renders nothing; a consumer that must state it names it in text.
`loading` renders a muted pulsing placeholder with aria-hidden, and no name.

score.description: The cumulative score in the name, for a trust audit.

label.description: The app's own words for the tier.

aria.description: A short title and a fuller accessible name.

aria: role="img" named by aria-label (the tier's name, or `label` / `ariaLabel`); the score is in the name only with `showScore`.
The glyph is aria-hidden; the loading placeholder is aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: None: a tier's colour is its --tier-* role (defined once in the N1 tokens, #543), the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the badge is rendered on the server.

responsive: A fixed size per `size`; it never grows with its container.
contract:
contract
  slot is "mzizi-verified-badge"
  role is "img"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/mzizi-verified-badge"
  label is "Government Verified"
  when score label is "Contact Verified · Trust 0.2"
  when label label is "Registered nurse"
  when suspended label is "Account Suspended"
  when ancestral label is "Contact Verified — Memorial"
  when licensed class contains "size-8"
end

checks.say: The badge is a named image with its tier and level.
The tier's fill and ink are its own container pair.
Community wears terracotta's pair and the users glyph.
Contact Verified wears cobalt's pair and the phone glyph, at the small size.
Licensed wears tanzanite's pair and the award glyph.
showScore adds the score to the title too.
label replaces the built-in wording everywhere.
ariaLabel sets the accessible name alone; the title keeps the label.
showTooltip=false drops the title, not the name.
Suspended shows the ban glyph on the neutral pair.
Ancestral keeps the tier's pair with the memorial flower.
The loading placeholder is hidden and unnamed.

gaps: Before this contract the React build was a client component that coloured the badge with an inline `style` (the tier at 15%) and dimmed suspended and ancestral badges with opacity. Both builds now use the tier's APCA-gated container pair, with no inline style, and do not dim: the ban and flower glyphs, and the name, carry the status.
